notes.title: Dev Blog Vol.4 - So who contributed to the battle?👀
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This is Toru Nakamura, Director of Vivid World.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, I’d like to introduce something we’ve been quietly working on behind the scenes...[/p][p]Actually, it was your voices that inspired us to bring it to life:[/p][h3][b]The All-New 🤖[i]Battle Log System[/i]🤖[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/8398550adecc3e534a094ee30feb31131c09d831.png"][/img][/p][h2]🤔The voice, [b]“[i]It’s hard to tell who’s contributing in battle…[/i]”[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]One day on Discord, one member left a comment that really stuck with me:[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]“It’s hard to tell which unit is actually contributing during battle!”[/i][/b][/h3][p][/p][p]And I thought… Yep. Guilty as charged.[/p][p]Maybe the battle UI feels a bit too hectic at times.[/p][p]To be honest, this was something we had quietly been thinking about too.[/p][p]So when I saw your feedback, I couldn’t help but nod in agreement😭[/p][p][/p][p]That said, between all the back-and-forth of unit actions... and the need to display status effects in real time...there’s no way to avoid having information rapidly appear and disappear during combat.[/p][p]But still, we felt we could do better.[/p][p][/p][p]So after several brainstorms with the dev team, we challenged ourselves to find a solution that would be more intuitive, more readable, and more satisfying to use.[/p][p]And as a result…[/p][h3][b]A completely new system was born!💫[/b][/h3][p][/p][h2]📊See Contributions in Real Time: Introducing the [b][i]"Battle Log UI"[/i][/b][/h2][p][/p][p]With this new system, a [b][i]damage graph[/i][/b] now appears on the right side of the screen during battle.[/p][p]Each unit’s total damage dealt is tracked and updated in real time, right before your eyes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/007ba8fb4ab242176a620f11895d4757e3303888.gif"][/img][/p][p]The initial order of the graph matches your party’s formation.[/p][p]Once battle begins, the graph automatically reorders in real time based on damage dealt, so you can instantly see who's pulling their weight on the field.[/p][p]And yes… Lemuria’s damage is tracked too.[/p][p](And she often performs better than you might expect!)[/p][p][/p][p]As for the graph itself, it’s scaled relatively.[/p][p](The highest damage value is always displayed as 100%, and the rest adjust proportionally)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/856975893596a693fa301584434db86b62b11729.gif"][/img][/p][h2]👆Review and Reflect Anytime[/h2][p][/p][p]Even after a battle ends, you can still open the battle log window.[/p][p]Before jumping into the next fight, it’s a great chance to look back at the final results and see how everyone did.[/p][p][/p][p]For those of you (like me) who get totally absorbed in the heat of battle and forget to notice who’s actually doing what, this is your chance to catch those hidden MVPs🤣[/p][p]You might discover some new favorite units by examining how much they contributed without ever realizing it![/p][p][/p][p]Just a heads-up: the log resets after each battle, so it’s really designed to help you reflect on who contributed what in that one specific fight.[/p][p]Also, if the screen starts feeling too crowded, just tap the "⚔️" icon on the right side of the screen to minimize the damage graph and keep things tidy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/ddbcc5eaa14f5d58f22e1682b26c9017dc5df768.gif"][/img][/p][h2]💎In Closing[/h2][p][/p][p]This Battle Log system wouldn’t exist if it weren’t for your feedback![/p][p]We took the theme of “visualizing contributions”, which may sound simple, but is incredibly important, and we worked hard to present it in a way that’s both instantly clear and doesn’t break the game’s pacing.[/p][p]This feature marks another important step in Vivid World’s evolution.[/p][p]When the game’s out, I really hope you’ll give it a try![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for reading all the way to the end![/p][p]As for the next dev blog topic… well, truth is, I haven’t decided yet![/p][p]Until then, I’ll see you in the next dev blog.[/p][p][/p][p]Toru Nakamura[/p]

notes.title: Dev Blog Vol. 3 - How the Jewelers are coping with the next series
notes.content:
[p]Hi, Toru Nakamura here, the director of Vivid World.[/p][p]Apologies for the delay, but today, I’m excited to share a closer look at how randomness works when it comes to units in the game, and the new systems we’ve built around it.[/p][p]If you are one of us who has ever experienced that moment when that one unit that would perfect the party just wouldn't show up... [/p][p]This blog post is for you🖖[/p][p][/p][h2]🐭The Evolution of the Jewelers... and the Arrival of a Devilish Newcomer[/h2][p]In Vivid World, several familiar faces from Vivid Knight make a return. [/p][p]What's even better, they're joined by some brand-new characters as well.[/p][p]Allow me to introduce a group of characters that play a major role in shaping your encounters with units: [b]the Jewelers[/b].[/p][p]If you have played the DEMO, you must already know that the Jewelers are back.[/p][p]These characters pop up at random locations during your run and offer a selection of random units for sale.[/p][p]What unit do you get? That’s all up to fate.[/p][p]You’ll still pay 30 Carats for one unit, and refreshing their stock costs 15 Carats...same as before.[/p][p](Charging players just to look at different wares... now that’s some ruthless capitalism if you ask me!)[/p][p][/p][p]So what’s new this time around?[/p][p]For starters, their visual design has been completely revamped. [/p][p]But it doesn’t stop there. We’ve gone deeper with their personalities and added more character-driven lore to bring them to life in new ways.[/p][p]And yes… we’ve added an [b]entirely new jeweler character[/b] as well! [/p][p]Brings a fresh twist to these mid-run encounters![/p][p]The jewelers continue to be a core part of the Vivid series’s roguelite essence. [/p][p]Whether they’re helping you pivot your strategy or throwing unexpected surprises your way. [/p][p]Get ready to meet them all![/p][p][/p][h3]💎 Stein the Jeweler[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/6eaf74837b2d6435d15525112fef04c1dc97c553.png"][/img]A familiar face from Vivid Knight, the Jeweller returns once again to handle all your gem-trading needs, this time in the form of Grim Reaper👻[/p][p]Its appearance might seem a bit more serious and stoic this time around, but his core role remains the same: buying and selling jewels.[/p][p]We designed it with the image of a “student council president” from a school-themed anime... an upright, honor-student type who always plays by the rules.[/p][p][i]Personality Traits: Dutiful, demands compensation even for kindness, hopeless with directions.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]💎 Felsen the Nomad Jeweler[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/cedfbd5e3288245a9572db4b1716e1200f92dd71.png"][/img]Just like in Vivid Knight, a Nomad Jeweler appears mid-run to offer a selection of units focused on a specific symbol, perfect for shaping your strategy.[/p][p]It’s actually the older brother of Stein, but personality-wise, they couldn’t be more different.[/p][p]While Stein is strict and serious, Felsen is cheerful, easygoing, and a natural at customer service.[/p][p]It often praises Stein whenever the opportunity arises.[/p][p]Just like before, it will often be sighted in the later stages of your dungeon run, ready to help your party building.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Personality Traits: Upbeat, clever, savvy merchant.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]💎 Husslin the Demon Jeweler[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/6b7d73a110aeb07e39ee7b4128cab5b4f42131c8.png"][/img]A brand-new character debuting in Vivid World, Husslin appears randomly in the tougher, mid-to-late stages of the dungeon.[/p][p]Unlike the other jewelers, it is not a reaper but a devil who mimics the jewelry business with his own shady twist.[/p][p]Rumor has it that in his previous life, it was involved in all sorts of shady business.[/p][p]It has even modeled its appearance after Stein and Felsen… but what kind of deal does it plan to strike with Lemuria? 🤔[/p][p]Its mafia-like look isn’t just for show. His business practices are just as sketchy![/p][p]More details will be revealed later, so please stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][i]Personality Traits: Obsessed with making money, lacks pride or conscience, only takes actions that guarantee profit.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🧬New Feature: Jewelry Perfume[/h2][p]Next up, let us talk about Jewelry Perfume, a new item that lets players influence the unit lineup offered by jewelers.[/p][p][/p][h3]What is a Jewelry Perfume?[/h3][p]Jewelry Perfume is a special fragrance item you can bring into the dungeon.[/p][p]It alters the symbol color of the units sold by the Nomad Jeweler.[/p][p]For example, if you’re wearing a blue-symbol perfume when you visit the Nomad Jeweler, its entire stock will consist of blue-symbol units only🔵[/p][p]This gives you the power to target specific unit types and build your party around them more reliably.[/p][p]It’s not full control, but it’s a tool designed to nudge luck in your favor.[/p][p]There are also rare perfumes with special effects... the kind that might just save your run when things get tough.[/p][p][/p][p]As for how to get them…[/p][p]I would like to keep that a surprise for now. [/p][p]But here’s a hint: You might find someone willing to trade in a certain location.[/p][p]Rumor has it a perfumer is hiding out there… 🤫[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/634f0f409d2970b8e80c1123946e89bd69bbf4e0.png"][/img][/p][p]
In the previous series Vivid Knight, we received a lot of feedback, pointing out that they can never get the unit they want, or the Party building feels like pure RNG in this game.[/p][p]With Vivid World, we made some adjustments to address those concerns. [/p][p]That’s why we’ve introduced new systems like perfume and new jeweler characters, which let players influence their party-building luck to some extent.[/p][p]That said, the goal isn’t to build the go-to team with the desired units every single time.[/p][p]Instead, these features are designed to be tools that add vivid color to the randomness, not eliminate it.[/p][p]Whether to fight against fate, or go with its flow.[/p][p]We’ve built the game so that choice is entirely up to you.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for reading all the way to the end![/p][p]Next time, we’ll be diving into some updates on the battle UI improvements.[/p][p]See you again in the next dev blog![/p][p][/p][p]Toru Nakamura[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/d8bf99a09c9d48a0d0f06f1d1b6db1d994f4c24f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dev Blog Vol. 2 - Introducing: Union Skills💥
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This is Toru Nakamura, director of Vivid World.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, I’m excited to share a peek at a brand-new battle system we’ve been building behind the scenes: [/p][h2]💎Union Skill💎[/h2][p]This is one of the big additions we’re introducing as we push Vivid World beyond what we originally envisioned.[/p][p]I hope you’ll like what we’re cooking up![/p][p][/p][h2]🍎 Union Skill: A Bond Between Allies Turns Into Power[/h2][p]Union Skills are powerful combo techniques that trigger when two specific units become partners.[/p][p]This “partnership” unlocks under a certain condition, but we’re keeping the details under wraps just a bit longer🤫[/p][p](It’s nothing too complicated)[/p][p][/p][p]Once a partnership is formed, those two units will be able to unleash a unique Union Skill during battle⚡️[/p][p]The screenshot below is still a work-in-progress, but the idea is simple:[/p][p][b]If both partner units are on the field, a special skill becomes available.[/b][/p][p]And yes, we’re creating brand-new effects to give these moments the impact they deserve![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/416768426eae0dab0ff937dc62f0650f2e180a91.gif"][/img][/p][h2]🍎 So… What’s a [b][i]Partnership[/i][/b] Exactly?[/h2][p]Partnership is a one-on-one bond formed between units under certain conditions.[/p][p]Let’s say you upgrade Unit A for the first time during a run. At the same time, Unit B is randomly selected as their partner.[/p][p]Once this bond is formed, it’s mutual and locked in for that run.[/p][p]Even if you upgrade the unit again, their partner won’t change.[/p][p]After all, it wouldn’t feel right if your *partner* changed on a whim 🌞🌝[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/a1b01ef59dd25b11016138a1abc391d192ddb4bb.gif"][/img][/p][h2]🍎 What Triggers the Union Skill?[/h2][p]If two partner units are in your party and a certain condition is met during battle,[/p][p]their Union Skill will activate. It only triggers once per battle.[/p][p][/p][p]The kind of skill will be set according to the combination of their color symbols,[/p][p]adding another layer of strategic variety.[/p][p]And when it goes off, there’s a little cut-in to mark the moment.[/p][p]It feels quite satisfying when you pull it off💪[/p][p][/p][h2]🍎 In Closing[/h2][p]Union Skills aren’t just flashy finishers.[/p][p]They add a new layer of strategy built around team composition, tactical use, and timing.[/p][p]We wanted to bring something that combines both gameplay depth [/p][p]and a little drama of pairing two units together.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re still refining and polishing things, but I hope this gives you a taste of the [/p][p]direction we’re heading.[/p][p]Can’t wait for you to try them out![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for reading all the way to the end![/p][p](And yes… I did say I’d post monthly. Sorry for the delay 🙇‍♂️)[/p][p][/p][p]For the next post, I’m planning to talk about one of the familiar faces from Vivid Knight🐭[/p][p]We’ve added a few more interesting features to their role this time around, [/p][p]and hopefully longtime players will enjoy what we’ve done.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]See you in the next dev blog.[/p][p][/p][p]Toru Nakamura[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dev Blog Vol. 1 - About the release postponement
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
This is Toru Nakamura, Director of Vivid World.

First of all, I'd like to thank you for all your support, feedback, and encouragement!
My team and I regularly read all your comments and posts, often finding ourselves 
thinking, “Ah, that makes sense,” as if something clicks inside us.

Well, some of you may have already heard, but we’ve decided to push the release of 
Vivid World to later this year.
I’d like to take a moment to explain why, and what kind of progress we’re making.
From here on out, I plan to regularly share behind-the-scenes updates like this, 
so I hope you’ll drop by now and then to see how things are going.

[h2]🍎 About the Delay[/h2]
During our internal testing, we achieved a certain level of evaluation, 
and the feedback we received was generally positive. 
However, there was a common sentiment among us, that this isn’t where we stop.
We believed we could improve the game significantly. We knew we could go further, 
exceed expectations, and deliver something even stronger.

This realization led us to pause, step back, and decide to overhaul and refine what we had. 
Now, this redesign is taking shape, and we’re carefully incorporating everything needed to 
bring the game to completion... to deliver the best version of the game to you. 

When our most critical internal testers take back their earlier words and genuinely enjoy the game, 
we will know we can confidently release it for the world to see. 
We are committed to providing a true sense of satisfaction in the final product.

[h2]🍎 Key Updates & Improvements[/h2]
[h3]1️⃣ The “Out-Game” Elements... Rebuilt from [b]SCRATCH[/b][/h3]
This was a tough one, but we made the call to [b]completely redesign[/b] the game systems and 
User Interface (UI) outside of dungeon and battle gameplay. 
You might be wondering what the heck I mean by the "out-game," as this part has 
not been implemented in the Demo yet.
But behind the scenes, we’ve been working hard on this area too.
For example, there was a system called [b]Shards[/b] that got some attention in our Discord chats.
It was a cool concept that allowed players to strengthen individual units over time. 
But in the end, we realized that the whole concept of this feature conflicted with the 
pace and philosophy of a rogue-like game.
So, we made the difficult decision to scrap it.

It’s always painful to throw away a system we’ve put so much time and heart into. 
But if doing so leads to a more enjoyable experience overall, then it’s the right call.
And no worries, we’re introducing a couple of new mechanics inside the dungeons to compensate. 
There’s plenty to look forward to!

[h3]2️⃣ “In-Game” Content... More Strategic Depth[/h3]
Since the release of the demo, we've received a lot of feedback expressing a desire for 
the ability to upgrade units individually. We hear you!
So, we’re introducing some new systems that will add deeper layers of strategy 
in ways that may surprise you. 
While I can't share all the details just yet, we're exploring ideas such as:
[list]
[*] Certain units interact in unique ways
[*] Mechanisms that tweak unit appearance rates
[/list]
 ...and other features that add new dimensions to party building.
Our goal is to provide you with new options and decisions to make, all while ensuring 
the game remains intuitive and fun.

[h3]3️⃣ Character Controls... Smoother Than Ever[/h3]
We’re also improving how it feels to play.
It might sound minor, but a small improvement in how a character moves or 
reacts can have a big impact on the overall experience.
We’re adjusting and polishing until the moment-to-moment gameplay feels right.

[h2]🍎 Our Goal: Surpass Vivid Knight[/h2]
One of our objectives in developing Vivid World is to create a game that reaches 
[b]more players[/b] than Vivid Knight while providing an even [b]deeper experience[/b].  
That said… as we added new systems, we ran into a challenge:

[i]How do we balance[b] richness [/b]with [b]clarity[/b]?[/i]

We don’t want to overwhelm you with the flooding amount of gimmicks from the start.
To address this, we’ve designed the game so that systems unlock gradually over time, 
helping players ease into the complexity without feeling lost.
It’s all about achieving a balance between depth and accessibility, 
and we’re tuning every detail with care.

[h2]🍎 Where We Stand Now[/h2]
Right now, I’d say the game is around 90% complete.
However, this is just our internal assessment for the time being. 
We plan to conduct another round of internal testing to determine if we can confidently 
say that this is it.
We’re ready to rework that last 10%… or even take a step back if we have to.
Our goal is to ensure that we deliver a game we truly believe in. 
So please, hang in there with us just a little longer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/04546dd9c428bcf862fd5b548b30950282de78dd.png[/img]

Thank you so much for reading all the way through.

I’ll continue to share our thoughts, our direction, and what’s happening behind the scenes 
as often as I can.
If you’re willing to walk with us a little longer, I promise it’ll be worth it.

See you in the next dev blog.

Toru Nakamura

notes.title: Decision to Postpone the Release + Devlog starts this month
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

Over the past few months, we have been working hard giving birth to our upcoming title, Vivid World. 
We are extremely grateful for the valuable feedback we have received from all of you during this time. Your insights and passionate comments have been a great source of motivation for us, helping Vivid World reach its true potential.

Today, we would like to update you on the status of Vivid World's full release.
We made the difficult decision to revise the release timing for Vivid World. The new planned release is now set for sometime in [b]2025[/b], which may mean a postponement until the [b]end of the year[/b].

As the initially planned release date approached, we felt an increasing pressure to deliver Vivid World in a state that meets the high standards we all expect from the previous title Vivid Knight.
We feel that there are still more improvements we can make before we confidently launch the game as an "Asobism"-developed title.
This decision stems from our love and commitment to the dedicated fan base of our earlier games.

To keep you updated on our progress, we plan to start a [b]devlog series[/b] on Steam News and our official Discord server, delivered in both English and Japanese! 
Through this, we can share our development journey as a team and gain exclusive insights into creating Vivid World.
The first post is planned to launch by the end of this month.

We greatly appreciate your fantastic feedback over the past months, and we apologize for not adhering to the original schedule. 

Will let you know when the first devlog arrives!
We hope you will stay with us for a few more months as we work towards releasing the absolute best version of Vivid World.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44610082/04546dd9c428bcf862fd5b548b30950282de78dd.png[/img]
Thanks for your time.

Love,
